start: Members page, signed in, gym has members

steps.action: Open Members
user_sees: Title 'Members' with '{n} members' under it, tabs 'All members' and 'Joined in the app', buttons '+ Add member' and 'Import from Excel'
must_not: A count that differs from the rows shown under 'All'
Archived members counted in '{n} members'

steps.action: Tap '+ Add member', type Full name and Mobile number, tap 'Add member'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Add member'
Button shows 'Saving…' while it saves
Sheet closes and the new member is in the list
must_not: Member saved twice
More boxes than name and mobile number needed to save
Sheet closing when the save failed

steps.action: Type part of the name in 'Search name or mobile number', tap the member
user_sees: The member's page: name as title, 'Member since {day}', button 'Edit', tiles 'Dues', 'Last visit', 'Total visits', sections 'Memberships', 'Payments', 'Details'
must_not: Another member's dues or payments shown
Search that misses the member just added

steps.action: Tap 'Edit', change the mobile number, tap 'Save changes'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Edit member' closes; the new number shows under Details 'Mobile'
must_not: Archived state or photo changed by the edit
Old number still shown after the save

start: Member's page (or the Add member sheet), gym online and its server keeps photos

steps.action: Tap the photo button on the member's page
user_sees: Camera sheet with 'Starting the camera… If the browser asks, tap Allow.', then the live picture with an oval and 'Ask the member to look at the camera, with their face inside the oval.'

user_sees: 'Check that the face is clear. Tap Use photo to keep it.'
'Only your gym’s staff can see this photo. It shows on the member’s page, their member card and at check-in.'
The photo on the member's page
must_not: Photo flipped compared with the preview
Photo saved on another member
Photo visible to the member's gym mates or on the public web page

start: Members page opened from a Today tile or with a filter chip

steps.action: Tap the chip 'Has dues' (or 'Expired', 'Expiring', 'Active', 'No membership', 'PT ending', 'Archived') and pick a batch in 'Filter by batch'
user_sees: Only members who fit both; each chip count is what a tap shows; with nobody: 'Nobody on the list fits this filter right now.' and 'Show all members'
must_not: A chip count that differs from the rows shown
Pass members listed under 'Has dues'

steps.action: Tap 'WhatsApp all {n}, one by one'
user_sees: The send-one-by-one sheet for exactly the people on the list
must_not: A message sent without a tap per person
Members outside the filter added to the queue

steps.action: Leave Full name empty, type a 6-digit mobile number, tap 'Add member'
user_sees: Every wrong box marked at once, the first one scrolled into view and focused; nothing saved
must_not: A member saved with no name or a short number
Only the first wrong box marked

steps.action: Type the mobile number of a member already on the list, tap 'Add member'
user_sees: Under the number: '{name} already has this mobile number in Members.'
must_not: A second member with the same number
A bare 'Could not save this member. Please try again.' with no reason

steps.action: Type the number of an archived member, tap 'Add member'
user_sees: A notice naming the archived member with a button to restore them
must_not: A dead end naming a member who cannot be found
A duplicate created beside the archived one

steps.action: Tick 'Comes with a pass (FITPASS, cultpass and others)', leave the company empty, save
user_sees: 'Pick or type the pass company.'
must_not: A pass member saved with no company

user_sees: 'Pick or type the pass company.'

steps.action: Tap 'Archive member'
user_sees: Toast 'Member archived.', pill 'Archived'; the member leaves 'All' and sits under the 'Archived' chip
must_not: Payments or visits deleted
Archived member still counted in Today's lists

steps.action: Open the 'Archived' chip, open the member, tap 'Restore member'
user_sees: Member back in the list with the same dues, plan and visits as before
must_not: Dues or plan dates changed by archive and restore

steps.action: On a membership row tap 'Cancel', type a reason of 3 letters or more, confirm 'Cancel this membership?'; then tap 'Undo cancel'
user_sees: Membership shown as cancelled with the reason, then live again
must_not: Cancel possible with no reason
Undo leaving the dues wrong

start: A member's page, signed in as front desk

steps.action: Tap 'Archive member', then open the 'Archived' chip and tap 'Restore member'
user_sees: Toast 'Member archived.', pill 'Archived'; after restore the member is back unchanged
must_not: Payments or visits deleted
Dues changed by archive and restore

steps.action: Look at a membership row and a payment row
user_sees: No 'Cancel', no freeze, no 'Cancel receipt' and no 'Extend' button; a PT pack says 'Only the owner can extend it.'
must_not: A greyed-out owner button
A cancel or freeze that the server refuses only after staff typed a reason

start: Member's page with photo, phone, address, emergency contact and notes

user_sees: Mobile, Email, Date of birth, Address, Emergency contact, Notes; the photo; the member ID card
must_not: These details shown to someone outside this gym
Photo shown anywhere but the member's page, card and check-in
Name or phone inside the card's QR
